title: Aakhri waqt hai marney ki rezaa do Zainab
body:
Aakhri waqt hai marney ki rezaa do Zainab
Apney haathoun sey kafan mujhko pinhaa do Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Waqt ronay ka nahin aankhon sey aansoo poncho
Bhaayi ko hauslaa-e-sabr-o-rezaa do Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Farz ki raah mein utthey na mohabbat ka sawaal
Hai Sakina dar-e-qhaimey sey hattaa do Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Uff na karna jo kalaayi mein rasan bandh jaaye
Sabr amma ka zamaaney ko dikhaa do Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Hothay Abbas toh takleef na deithay tum ko
Ek majboor ko ghoday pey bitthaado Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Muntazir shimr ka khanjar hai meri gardhan ka
Zindagi ki nahin marney ki rezaa do Zainab
